notes: THEM che do clone tieng Viet moi: VieNeu v3 Turbo - chay CPU bang ONNX nhanh hon thoi gian thuc, khong can card do hoa, mau chi can 3-8 giay va khong can go loi thoai mau, am thanh 48 kHz, giay phep Apache-2.0 (dung cho kenh kiem tien duoc). Dung CHUNG kho Giong da luu voi F5 (giong Nhung chon lai la dung ngay). Tool tu cai thu vien VieNeu o lan dung dau tien.
